capabilities.details: 20 tool contracts registered. Registry supports get, register, unregister, list_by_category/permission/risk/isolation, validate_input/output.

Each contract has: name, category, description, input_schema (Pydantic), output_schema (Pydantic), required_permissions, risk_level (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL), isolation (NONE/SANDBOX/SANDBOX_WRITE/GRANT_GATED), timeout_seconds, retry_policy, audit_event, log_args, log_output, idempotent, side_effects. All 20 contracts fully defined with schemas.

MissionTaskAgent.execute() now uses context.tool_executor.execute_tool('artifact_write', ...) for artifact creation. ToolExecutor handles contract validation, permission checks, human gate integration, Action record creation, event emission, and sandbox execution. This is the PRIMARY production tool invocation path.

Sandbox creates per-sandbox artifacts directory at ${artifacts_base_dir}/${sandbox_id}. Windows adapter uses temp directory. No worktree/git worktree integration. No workspace scoping per agent/task beyond sandbox isolation.

SandboxManager enforces: single execute per sandbox_id, image allowlist, resource limits (memory, CPU, processes, wall_time), grant validation, event emission. WindowsExecutorAdapter implements ExecutionSandbox protocol with Job Objects for partial isolation (memory, CPU time, process count limits). Fallback to subprocess when pywin32 unavailable. Network mode hardcoded to NONE.

ResourceLimits: memory_bytes, cpu_percent, cpu_time_seconds, max_processes, wall_time_seconds, network_mode=NONE. Windows Job Objects enforce: JobMemoryLimit, ProcessMemoryLimit, CPU rate control, ActiveProcessLimit, PerProcessUserTimeLimit. Default limits: 2GB memory, 100% CPU (1 core), 300s CPU time, 100 processes, 300s wall time.
DEFAULT_IMAGE_ALLOWLIST includes: python:3.11-slim, node:20-alpine, ubuntu:22.04, alpine:3.19, busybox:latest. Configurable via SandboxManager constructor.

SandboxManager validates grants before execute(). ToolExecutor._check_permissions() validates required_permissions against context.grant_ids via context.grant_validator. Fail-closed: no validator = PermissionError.

Action created with action_id, attempt_id, tool_name, tool_args. Updated with completed_at, success, output, error, evidence_id, sandbox_id. Registered in both ToolExecutor._actions and Engine.actions for global tracking.
Emits ACTION_REQUESTED with action_id, attempt_id, tool_name, tool_args, mission_id, run_id, task_id, agent_id, timestamp.
Emits ACTION_VALIDATED with action_id, tool_name, valid, reason, errors.
Emits TOOL_COMPLETED with action_id, tool_name, output_summary, duration_ms, artifacts, evidence_id.
Emits TOOL_FAILED with action_id, tool_name, error, error_type, duration_ms.

All 7 filesystem tools implemented with workspace path resolution, input validation, output schema validation, SHA256 hashing. read_file, write_file, edit_file, list_dir, grep, find_files, file_browser.
All 5 git tools implemented using subprocess git commands with workspace scoping. git_branch, git_commit, git_diff, git_status, git_push.
web_search and web_fetch implemented with requests library. Input/output validation via contracts.
run_command, sandbox_execute, artifact_write, artifact_read execute within sandbox with resource limits, grant validation, artifact capture with SHA256.
verification_check tool validates evidence integrity, artifact hashes, chain completeness.
grant_validate tool checks grant validity for permissions.

HIGH/CRITICAL risk tools trigger human gate via engine.create_human_gate(). Mission transitions: EXECUTING -> HUMAN_REQUIRED -> EXECUTING (approve) or CANCELLED (reject). Per-gate decision tracking prevents duplicate decisions. Action-level gates keyed by tool_name for reuse after approval.

FileEvidenceStore persists artifacts and evidence records. Each artifact has SHA256, size, mission_id, created_by (action_id). Evidence records link to source artifacts with content_type and source_id. Tampering detected via hash verification on read.
SHA256 computed on write, stored in Artifact and EvidenceRecord. Verification re-computes hash on read and compares. Tampering detected if mismatch.

Checkpoints capture: mission, run, task graph state, task states, artifact_ids, evidence_hashes, attempt_history, agent_assignments, human_gate, human_decision. Resume restores full state and continues execution.

Mission states: RECEIVED, ANALYZING, PLANNING, DESIGNING, REVIEWING, APPROVED, AWAITING_APPROVAL, EXECUTING, HUMAN_REQUIRED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FAILED. Validated transitions with MISSION_STATE_CHANGED events.
Task states: PENDING, READY, ASSIGNED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, BLOCKED. Validated transitions with STATE_TRANSITION events. Dependency enforcement via _check_and_unblock_dependents.
Atomic agent reservation per attempt with exclusion for retry reassignment. Agent lifecycle: AVAILABLE -> ASSIGNED -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED/FAILED. Pool of 12 mission agents.
True parallelism with max_parallel limit. Dependency-aware scheduling. Retry logic with exponential backoff. Task-level timeout. Checkpoint every N completed tasks.

gaps_for_E9: 1. No generic tool dispatcher - agents hardcode sandbox.write_artifact() -> CLOSED: MissionTaskAgent now uses ToolExecutor
2. No Action record creation during tool execution -> CLOSED: ToolExecutor creates and registers Actions
3. No ActionRequestedEvent/ActionValidatedEvent emission -> CLOSED: ToolExecutor emits all three events
4. No tool contract validation at execution time (input/output) -> CLOSED: ToolExecutor validates input/output against contracts
5. Filesystem/Git/Web tools are mock (contracts exist but no executors) -> CLOSED: All 19 tool implementations exist in ToolExecutor
6. No workspace scoping per agent/task -> PARTIAL: Sandbox provides isolation, but no git worktree per task
7. No grant admission control for tool invocation -> CLOSED: ToolExecutor._check_permissions enforces grants
8. No credential handling -> OPEN: No secret/credential injection mechanism
9. No human gate integration at action/tool level -> CLOSED: ToolExecutor._check_human_gate integrated
10. No evidence integrity verification (tamper detection) -> CLOSED: FileEvidenceStore verifies hashes on read
